original_text: Types of Tissues Tissues are a collection of specialized cells organized to perform a common function 4 main categories of tissue: Epithelial Connective Muscular Nervous
explanation: A tissue is defined as a collection of specialized cells organized to perform a common physiological function. In animals, tissues are classified into four primary categories: epithelial tissue, connective tissue, muscular tissue, and nervous tissue.

questions.q: What are the four primary categories of animal tissues?
questions.exp: The four main categories of animal tissue are epithelial, connective, muscular, and nervous tissue.
